```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(officer)
library(flextable)
library(AICcmodavg)
library(lme4)
```

```{r}


fix_modnames <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>%
  mutate(Modnames = str_replace_all(Modnames, "_", " + "),
         Modnames = str_replace_all(Modnames, "\\.", " * "),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "cohesion", "Cohesion"),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "patchrd", "CrossWoody"),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "treshr", "% Woody"),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "impervious", "% Impervious"),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "bridgebinary", "Bridge/culvert"),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "class", "Class"),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "sex", "Sex"),
         Modnames = str_replace(Modnames, "age", "Age"),
         Modnames = str_replace_all(Modnames, "2", "²"))
}

aic_flextabler <- function(df) {
  df  %>% 
  mutate(across(c(AICc, Delta_AICc, LL, AICcWt), ~round(., 3))) %>% 
  select(Modnames, K, AICc, Delta_AICc, LL) %>% 
  flextable() %>% 
  set_header_labels(Modnames = "Fixed structure",
                    Delta_AICc = "\u0394 AICc",
                    LL = "log(Lik)") %>% 
  autofit() %>% 
  fit_to_width(max_width = 7)

}

```
  
  
  All lions combined  
  
```{r}

readRDS(here("model_objects/base_crossing_models"))$aic %>% 
  fix_modnames() %>% 
  aic_flextabler()

```

\pagebreak  
    
Estimated coefficients and bootstrapped 95% confidence intervals for the best model in each data group.   
```{r eval = FALSE}
# run this one if using models fitted separately to age/sex groups

output_models = list("best_model_all_lions_combined" = readRDS(here("model_objects/base_crossing_models"))$cohesion2_treshr2_impervious2_patchrd_bridgebinary_class,
                     "best_model_females" = readRDS(here("model_objects/base_crossing_models_female"))$cohesion2_treshr_impervious2_patchrd_bridgebinary_class,
                     "best_model_males" = readRDS(here("model_objects/base_crossing_models_male"))$cohesion2_treshr2_impervious2_patchrd_bridgebinary_class,
                     "best_model_adults" = readRDS(here("model_objects/base_crossing_models_adult"))$cohesion2_treshr2_impervious2_patchrd_bridgebinary_class,
                     "best_model_subadults" = readRDS(here("model_objects/base_crossing_models_subadult"))$cohesion_treshr_impervious2_patchrd_bridgebinary_class)


fixed_effects_coefs <- map_df(output_models, ~ {
  coefs <- fixef(.x)
  ses <- sqrt(diag(vcov(.x)))
  
  tibble(
    term = names(coefs),
    estimate = coefs,
    std_error = ses
  )
}, .id = "model")


fixed_effects_boot_ci <- bind_rows(readRDS(here("model_objects/boot_coef_ci_1000sim_best_mod_all_lions")) %>% 
                                mutate(model = "best_model_all_lions_combined"),
                              readRDS(here("model_objects/boot_coef_ci_1000sim_best_mod_female")) %>% 
                                mutate(model = "best_model_females"),
                              readRDS(here("model_objects/boot_coef_ci_1000sim_best_mod_male")) %>% 
                                mutate(model = "best_model_males"),
                              readRDS(here("model_objects/boot_coef_ci_1000sim_best_mod_adult")) %>% 
                                mutate(model = "best_model_adults"),
                              readRDS(here("model_objects/boot_coef_ci_1000sim_best_mod_subadult")) %>% 
                                mutate(model = "best_model_subadults"))



fixed_effects_df_clean <- full_join(fixed_effects_boot_ci, fixed_effects_coefs) %>% 
  filter(term != "(Intercept)")


fixed_effects_df_clean <- fixed_effects_df_clean %>%
  mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, "poly\\(", ""),
         term = str_replace_all(term, ", 2\\)1", ""),
         term = str_replace_all(term, ", 2\\)", ""),
         term = str_replace_all(term, "TRUE", ""),
         term = str_replace(term, "cohesion", "Cohesion"),
         term = str_replace(term, "cohesion", "Cohesion"),
         term = str_replace(term, "patchrd", "CrossWoody"),
         term = str_replace(term, "tre.shr", "% Woody"),
         term = str_replace(term, "impervious", "% Impervious"),
         term = str_replace(term, "bridge.binary", "Bridge/culvert"),
         term = str_replace(term, "class", "Class-"),
         term = str_replace(term, "sexM", "Sex-Male"),
         term = str_replace(term, "agesub-adult", "Age-Sub adult"),
         term = str_replace_all(term, "2", "²")
         )

fixed_effects_df_clean <- fixed_effects_df_clean %>% 
  mutate(across(c(estimate, std_error, lower, upper), ~round(.,2))) %>% 
  mutate(out.val = paste(estimate, " (", lower, ", ", upper, ")", sep = ""))



fixed_effects_df_wide <- fixed_effects_df_clean %>%
  mutate(model = str_replace_all(model, "best_model", ""),
         model = str_replace_all(model, "_", " ")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(term), names_from = model, values_from = out.val)



fixed_effects_df_wide %>% 
  flextable() %>% 
  autofit() %>% 
  fit_to_width(max_width = 7)
  


```

```{r}
# run this one if using models fitted with age and sex interactions

output_models = list("round_2_best_model" = readRDS(here("model_objects/round2_crossing_models"))$cohesion2_treshr2_impervious2_patchrd_bridgebinary_sex.class,
                     "round_2_2nd_best_model" = readRDS(here("model_objects/round2_crossing_models"))$cohesion2_treshr2_sex.impervious2_patchrd_bridgebinary_class)


fixed_effects_coefs <- map_df(output_models, ~ {
  coefs <- fixef(.x)
  ses <- sqrt(diag(vcov(.x)))
  
  tibble(
    term = names(coefs),
    estimate = coefs,
    std_error = ses
  )
}, .id = "model")



fixed_effects_boot_ci <- bind_rows(readRDS(here("model_objects/boot_coef_ci_1000sim_rnd2_best_mod")) %>% 
                                mutate(model = "round_2_best_model"),
                              readRDS(here("model_objects/boot_coef_ci_1000sim_rnd2_2nd_best_mod")) %>% 
                                mutate(model = "round_2_2nd_best_model"))



fixed_effects_df_clean <- full_join(fixed_effects_boot_ci, fixed_effects_coefs) %>% 
  filter(term != "(Intercept)")


fixed_effects_df_clean <- fixed_effects_df_clean %>% 
  mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, ", raw = TRUE", ""))%>%
  mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, "poly\\(", ""),
         term = str_replace_all(term, ", 2\\)1", ""),
         term = str_replace_all(term, ", 2\\)", ""),
         term = str_replace_all(term, "TRUE", ""),
         term = str_replace(term, "cohesion", "Cohesion"),
         term = str_replace(term, "cohesion", "Cohesion"),
         term = str_replace(term, "patchrd", "CrossWoody"),
         term = str_replace(term, "tre.shr", "% Woody"),
         term = str_replace(term, "impervious", "% Impervious"),
         term = str_replace(term, "bridge.binary", "Bridge/culvert"),
         term = str_replace(term, "class", "Class-"),
         term = str_replace(term, "sexM", "Sex-Male"),
         term = str_replace(term, "agesub-adult", "Age-Sub adult"),
         term = str_replace_all(term, "2", "²")
         )

fixed_effects_df_clean <- fixed_effects_df_clean %>% 
  mutate(across(c(estimate, std_error, lower, upper), ~round(.,2))) %>% 
  mutate(out.val = paste(estimate, " (", lower, ", ", upper, ")", sep = ""))



fixed_effects_df_wide <- fixed_effects_df_clean %>%
  mutate(model = str_replace_all(model, "best_model", ""),
         model = str_replace_all(model, "_", " ")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(term), names_from = model, values_from = out.val)



fixed_effects_df_wide %>% 
  flextable() %>% 
  autofit() %>% 
  fit_to_width(max_width = 7)
  


```


Cohesion, % Woody, and % Impervious were Z-transformed  

Cohesion calculated with the landscapemetrics package following Schumaker, N. H. 1996. Using landscape indices to predict habitat connectivity. Ecology, 77(4), 1210-1225.  

CrossWoody coded as 1 if the road intersects a patch of woody vegetation (rather than woody veg being somewhere in the buffer distance around that road segment), 0 otherwise.  

Bridge/culvert coded as 1 if there is at least 1 bridge or culvert in the road segment, 0 otherwise.  

Road class is a 4 level factor with Local as the reference level
